why: The NPDev Full Maturity Closure Roadmap's boundary contract, machine-checked so it cannot silently drift. md-zero-2026-08-11 PLAN.md Phase 3 consolidated this from three places that had already drifted from each other: checkpoint names/evidence-file-list/classifications lived in this JSON AND as separately hardcoded PowerShell array literals inside run-maturity-max-roadmap-boundary-check.ps1 (duplicated, not derived); 'what Checkpoint 0 does not solve' had three DIFFERENT wordings (this script's own 7-item list, docs/maintainers/ROADMAP_BOUNDARY_POLICY.md's prose, docs/maintainers/MATURITY_CLOSURE_LEDGER.md's shorter prose); the classification taxonomy's meaning/action text differed in wording between ROADMAP_BOUNDARY_POLICY.md's two-column table and MATURITY_CLOSURE_LEDGER.md's one-column table for the same six values. This file is now the only place any of that is written; docs/maintainers/ROADMAP_BOUNDARY_POLICY.md, MATURITY_CLOSURE_LEDGER.md and POST_BETA0_HUMAN_ACTION_REGISTER.md are generated from it by scripts/docs/generate_maturity_max_roadmap_docs.py.
